hook: SHE *COMPARED HER SON. THEN SAW HIS *FACE.
title: F38 · my_kids_vs · "Why Can You Not Be Like..."
lines: n
Why can you not be more like Mehta aunty's son?
"Why can you not be more like Mehta aunty's son?"
n
She said it without thinking. Mothers do.
n
She watched something close in his face.
n
He finished eating. He said, Okay. He washed his plate.
He finished eating. He said, "Okay." He washed his plate.
n
That was worse than if he had shouted.
n
Clearing the table she remembered the story she herself had told him at five. Two brothers. One fruit.
n
And parents who never once asked the slow one to be the fast one.
n
She knocked on his door.
I do not want Mehta aunty's son, she said. I have never even liked that boy.
"I do not want Mehta aunty's son," she said. "I have never even liked that boy."
n
See the child you have. That is sadhana.
